top_signals.title: Bolsonaro Arrives in Miami After Fleeing Brazil, O Globo Says
top_signals.summary: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Miami on Tuesday after fleeing his country following a defeat in its presidential election, O Globo reported.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
